info.description: Management API of Harpocrates, the internal certificate authority: issuers, profiles, certificates, revocation and ACME accounts.

occurredAt.description: An ISO-8601 formatted string: when it happened

surface.description: Where from: api, cli, acme, renewal or system

subjectType.description: The kind of thing it concerns: issuer, certificate, key

subjectId.description: The ID of the thing it concerns

reason.description: The reason given, where one is required

hash.description: Its hash, which the next event's covers

valid.description: Whether every event's hash and link hold

brokenAt.description: The first event that does not hold

initialised.description: Whether the signer's store is initialised

sealed.description: Whether it is sealed: nothing signs while it is

ceremonyId.description: The signer's open ceremony, if any

IssuerTier.description: A CA's tier: roots and intermediates are offline, issuing CAs online

ip.description: IP addresses (for a CA's constraints, networks: 10.0.0.0/8)

email.description: Email addresses (for a CA's constraints, domains)

permitted.description: Subtrees every name must fall within, by type

excluded.description: Subtrees no name may fall within, by type

purpose.description: What an issuing CA is for: TLS, Service, Device, Signing

number.description: Tells apart CAs of the same purpose and tier

generation.description: Counts successors: a successor keeps the number

parentId.description: The CA that signed this one, when it is in Harpocrates

notAfter.description: An ISO-8601 formatted string: when the CA expires
